# GitHub Copilot Instructions — FloodGuard AI

All contributions must follow the root `AGENTS.md` file.

Before suggesting or implementing changes:
- Read the relevant project requirements and architecture.
- Inspect existing code.
- Reuse established components, types, and patterns.
- Keep changes within the requested scope.

Do not invent APIs, schemas, endpoints, environment variables, or functionality.

Do not independently change architecture, security, database policies, shared contracts, or risk-scoring logic.

Do not present mock data as live data.

Ask for clarification when requirements are incomplete or conflicting.

Never weaken security or bypass the product integrity rules.

All generated code must follow the mandatory instructions in `AGENTS.md`.
